note: Post-hoc categorization of the frozen blind run. Labels were not edited after seeing Cards. Implementation was not tuned.

layers.retrievalMiss: Top-1 path missed expected PDF on 22/89 answerable (Top-1 75%, Top-3 84%, Top-6 88%). Several lecture/policy questions ranked a different PDF.
layers.layoutSkip: cs229-notes.pdf: 27/28 pages skipped (uncertain math layout); only 2035 extracted chars. Lecture questions then retrieved other PDFs.
layers.twoColumnUndetected: attention.pdf (IEEE/NIPS two-column) recorded 0 two-column pages, 9 uncertain, 6 skipped. bert.pdf and resnet.pdf: 0 two-column, all uncertain.
layers.isolatedLineChunkExplosion: Uncertain pages index as isolated-lines. Production ingest refuses >200 chunks/PDF. Blind bench indexed uncapped chunks. Would-be ingest refusals: bert 781, cisa 945, lora 353, nist-800-207 1154, nist-800-63b 2080, omb 578, resnet 567, tracemonkey 726.
layers.questionSubjectMismatch: Casual/follow-up wording often retrieved a lexically similar but different document (hypothesis→TraceMonkey; ransomware→ZTA).
layers.safeSupportRejection: 27 answerable silences. Many are lexical-engine false silence, not support-gate overreach on a retrieved gold span.
layers.unsupportedSpoke: 20 lexically tempting unanswerable questions produced supported Cards (disclose/patent, GPU/Transformers, Satoshi email, Devlin name, home/dotgov). Evidence gate admitted them.
layers.samePageStrictSpan: 17 same-page spoken Cards failed the pre-written span string (hyphenation, partial sentence). Not treated as label corrections. Not counted as hits.
layers.tableFigure: Dense tables (ResNet Table 1–5, BERT GLUE table, Bitcoin z/P table) were not used as answerable labels; unanswerable growth-rate/CAGR stayed in the attack set.
layers.outsideLimits: rfc9110 194 pages refused; nist-800-12 101 pages refused; irs-p15 59 pages / 303k chars refused.

safetyCases.rule: Section 28: unanswerable spoke Cards and wrong-document Cards are wrong-intent. Saved in card-run.json safetyFail. No implementation change.
